candidates.exact_span: The annual whole sludge application rate for the sewage sludge that does not cause any of the cumulative pollutant loading rates in Table 2 above to be exceeded, unless the pollutant concentrations in Table 3 found in Element I, Section III below are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Determines whether compliance is evaluated against the annual whole sludge application rate tied to Table 2 cumulative pollutant loading limits, or alternatively against Table 3 pollutant concentration criteria; different readings of the 'unless' condition change which numeric limit applies.

candidates.exact_span: If bulk sewage sludge is applied to land in a State other than the State in which the sludge is prepared, written notice shall be provided prior to the initial land application to the permitting authority for the State in which the bulk sewage sludge is proposed to be applied.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether bulk sludge is applied out-of-state determines if the pre-application written-notice obligation is triggered; interpretation of 'prepared' versus applied location affects whether this permit condition is applicable.

candidates.exact_span: The name, address, telephone number, and National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System permit number (if appropriate) for the person who prepares the bulk sewage sludge.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The '(if appropriate)' qualifier governs when an NPDES permit number must be included in required notice; different interpretations change what identifying information is required and what constitutes adequate documented evidence.

candidates.exact_span: The name, address, telephone number, and National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System permit number (if appropriate) for the person who will apply the bulk sewage sludge.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Same '(if appropriate)' condition for the applier's NPDES permit number; whether a number is required affects notice-content obligations and whether missing permit identifiers reflect a documented no-data state or inadequate evidence.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall give 60 days prior notice to the Director of any change planned in the sewage sludge practice.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a time-bound notification obligation before sludge-practice changes; whether a planned change qualifies and whether 60-day notice was given affects applicability of associated permit conditions.

candidates.exact_span: Any change shall include any planned physical alterations or additions to the permitted treatment works, changes in the permittee's sludge use or disposal practice, and also alterations, additions, or deletions of disposal sites.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines the scope of 'change' that triggers the 60-day notice requirement; different readings of what constitutes a sludge use/disposal practice change or site addition/deletion change which events require prior notice.

candidates.exact_span: These changes may justify the application of permit conditions that are different from or absent in the existing permit, including notification of additional disposal sites not reported during the permit application process or absent in the existing permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Links qualifying changes to potential imposition of new or different permit conditions; interpretation affects which limits and notification obligations become applicable after a change.

candidates.exact_span: Change in the sludge use or disposal practice may because for modification of the permit in accordance with 40 CFR 122.62(a)(1).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Ties sludge-practice changes to permit modification under 40 CFR 122.62(a)(1); whether a change is sufficient to trigger modification affects which enforceable permit terms (including limits and conditions) govern subsequent periods.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall provide the location of all existing sludge disposal/use sites to the State Historical Commission within 90 days of the effective date of this permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a deadline-bound reporting obligation for existing site locations; whether the 90-day window and effective-date trigger are met affects whether site-location evidence is established or remains unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: In addition, the permittee shall provide the location of any new disposal/use site to the State Historical Commission prior to use of the site.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Requires pre-use disclosure of new disposal/use sites; interpretation of when a site is 'new' or when 'use' begins determines whether this reporting obligation applied before operations at a site.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall within 30 days after notification by the State Historical Commission that a specific sludge disposal/use area will adversely affect a National Historic Site, cease use of such area.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Imposes a binding cessation obligation upon Commission notification; whether adverse-effect notification occurred and the 30-day window was observed changes applicable use restrictions and associated compliance obligations for affected sites.

candidates.exact_span: The person who prepares bulk sewage sludge or a sewage sludge material shall develop the following information and shall retain the information for five years.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes who must create and retain sludge records and for how long; interpretation of 'develop' and the five-year retention period affects whether recordkeeping/monitoring evidence obligations apply and whether absent records fall within an expected retention window.

candidates.exact_span: If the permittee supplies the sludge to another person who land applies the sludge, the permittee shall notify the land applier of the requirements for recordkeeping found in 40 CFR 503.17 for persons who land apply.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Triggers a chain-of-custody notification obligation when sludge is supplied to a third-party land applier; whether sludge was supplied versus self-applied determines if this cross-party recordkeeping notice requirement applies and where evidence obligations reside.

candidates.exact_span: The concentration (mg/Kg) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 3 found in Element I, Section III and the applicable pollutant concentration criteria (mg/Kg), or the applicable cumulative pollutant loading rate and the applicable cumulative pollutant loading rate limit (kg/ha) listed in Table 2 above.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies which pollutant measurements and numeric criteria must be recorded (Table 3 concentration criteria versus Table 2 cumulative loading rates); the 'or' alternative changes which limits are compared against reported concentrations, which data must be retained/monitored, and what evidence is expected when results are absent.
